analyst_view.overall: Early view: Tenerife beat Ceuta 2-0 on Sunday in their first game since the death of Jesús de Miguel, with Nacho Gil scoring and setting up Neal Viereck's header from a corner. Mallorca drew 3-3 at home to Córdoba, saved by Sergi Darder's stoppage-time volley, and are unbeaten in six; one report says the club dismissed football director Pablo Ortells on Sunday.

goals.text: The numbers say 2.1 goals. I have moved from lower to same: Mallorca's draws had been tight, but they just conceded three at home to Córdoba, and Tenerife looked sharper in front of goal against Ceuta than in their run of four draws.

corners.text: The numbers say 8.7 corners and I keep it. Neither side has dominated games lately, and Tenerife's set pieces from Nacho Gil are a threat but do not change the count much.

cards.text: The numbers say 5.6 cards. Tenerife-Ceuta produced only four yellows and Mallorca had just one against Córdoba, but with no referee named I hold at the site's figure.

shots.text: The numbers say 22.1 shots, a low figure that fits two cautious sides. Nothing in the latest results moves it clearly.

shots_on_target.text: The numbers say 6.7 shots on target. I have moved from lower to same in line with the goals, since Mallorca's last game was far more open than their earlier away draws.
